verdict.rationale: Relay is a business banking SaaS platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, an agent connection endpoint, or a public API. The llms.txt file and the QuickBooks, Xero and Plaid integrations are adjacent features and do not count as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
